name: XCC_SIM_HEADERS
description: Stores transaction information for a pseudo application used for testing the budgetary control engine.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type of the pseudo application transaction

columns.name: SOURCE_HEADER_ID_1
columns.description: Second part of the unique identifier for the pseudo application transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_HEADER_ID_2
columns.description: Thrid part of the unique identifier for the pseudo application transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number of the pseudo application transaction.

columns.name: DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Destination type of the pseudo application transaction (Expense or Invemtory)

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction source of the pseudo application transaction.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Document type of the pseudo application transaction.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: General Ledger journal source of the pseudo application transaction.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger of the pseudo application transaction in those cases where the transaction refrences only a single ledger.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Business unit of the pseudo application transaction in those cases where the transaction references only a single business unit.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Budgetary control data set. Identifies the data to be processed by a particular budgetary control request.

columns.name: FUNDS_CHECK_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Budgetary control status of this transaction as of the last funds check done on this transaction.

columns.name: FUNDS_RESERVATION_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Budgetary control status of this transaction as of the last funds reserve done on this transaction.

columns.name: HEADER_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Used to control whether multiple transactions should be grouped together for budgetary control purpose. If provided, any transactions with the same value for this column will pass or fail budgetary control as a unit.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
